frame_indexing: Zero-based source decoded frames. Intervals are [start,end). Source is 29.97002997 fps, not exactly 30.
measurement_note: Distances and hex colors are visual estimates, not world coordinates or colorimeter samples. Frame precision applies to visible events; obscured contact is explicitly bounded. No HUD coin/name labels are visible.
review: Whole video viewed at 6 fps; every source frame 330–1649 viewed in 44 contact sheets; selected frames enlarged. Old reports read only after the independent frame pass.
official_name: Pin and Trim Along the Patterns
mapping_evidence: Exactly three contact episodes: f811, f858, f905–910. Overhead arcs f830–856 are preparation, not a fourth hit.
Three coins, Slash kit, floral shears pin/cut motif.

weapon.type: Ornate oversized tailoring shears / separable scissor blades
weapon.held: One-handed grip near the floral hinge/handle when attached; raised free hand directs detached blades. Individual fingers and hand side are not consistently resolvable.
weapon.parts: Long paired narrow pointed dark blades, angular open diamond/polygon handle loops, pale flower cluster at the hinge, segmented/linked-looking silver contours. Closed blades can resemble a spear; open blades establish the scissor shape.

props.object: Floral shears plus two plain companion blade shapes
props.path: Orbit in overlapping half-circles; align diagonally toward target f857; converge f858. Count is best visible at f857, with overlap uncertainty of one blade.

props.object: Long decorated shear/linked line at target
props.path: Remains aimed across gap while caster readies and then passes through.

Rodion/shears dash through target behind screen-filling white-pink blur; target contact is confirmed by f910.

Pull out, caster beyond target; no fourth hit.
